meta.name: Caught in the Crackdown
meta.description: Caught in the Crackdownis a comprehensive documentary tracking the violence, protests, and arrests stemming from the ‘federal immigration sweeps’ currently occurring across the United States. The film examines the tactics, legal cases, and impact of these operations, from Los Angeles to Chicago to Minneapolis, presenting a multitude of cases of excessive use of force, illegal operations, and dangerous and excessive use of police weapons and tactics.
